title: Rate administration.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided in this article, the commissioner shall implement and evaluate motorcycle and motor scooter insurance rates in compliance with article 14.
bodyHtml: §431:10G-206  Rate administration.  Except as otherwise provided in this article, the commissioner shall implement and evaluate motorcycle and motor scooter insurance rates in compliance with article 14. [L 1989, c 208, pt of §1]
